All of the other ponies were being unnecessarily mean (and frankly inaccurate) to Belle for his penis size, and I can prove it with math.

The average penis size is 5.1 inches, and “half the average” (5.1 / 2) is generally anything smaller than 2.5 inches. I will be giving belle 2.4 for the sake of generosity. 

The average height of a male human is 5.1 feet, which puts them at 68.9 inches. Belle is stated to be 83.5cm, or 2.7 ft/ 32.4 in.

Using these averages for humans, we can calculate that the average penis to body ratio is 7.4%. We can use this to calculate the average penis size of a certain height by doing 7.4% / height.

Belle is 32.4 inches; while his penis is likely 2.4 inches based off of Celestia’s words. If we use the ratio previously mentioned, the number comes out to about 2.39, this means that his penis is actually 0.01 inches larger than the average calculated. 

Therefore, Belle does not have a small penis; at least for his body size, it is average. Thank you for coming to my TEDtalk.
